headline: DISTRICT ATTORNEY’S OFFICE ANNOUNCES CHARGES AGAINST 14-YEAR-OLD’S MOTHER, OFELIA GARCIA ORTEGA, FOLLOWING INVESTIGATION INTO DEATH OF INFANT
summary: Monterey County District Attorney Jeannine M. Pacioni announced today that Ofelia Garcia Ortega has been charged following an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of a premature infant found deceased on August 1…
